name: first-through
description: A Mythras Imperative campaign for mythras-gm, built as a first roleplaying game for 10-15 year olds and set in the real stellar neighbourhood. Thirty billion people across twenty-eight systems joined by twenty-seven doors, and the only way between stars is one person at a time -- a child, because the older you are the likelier a crossing kills you. No signal crosses, so everything anybody knows about anywhere else was carried there by a courier and a friend. One one-sitting entry point, a living world of 12 agendas and 29 beats, and no pre-generated characters: every first-through is built fresh at the table, which is the opening scene. Danger is real and always named before it is taken.
